# provider-keycloak llms.txt
# See: https://llmstxt.org/

> provider-keycloak is a Crossplane provider that manages Keycloak (IAM/SSO) resources as Kubernetes custom resources. It is generated with Upjet from the Keycloak Terraform provider. Declare Keycloak realms, clients, users, groups, roles, identity providers, and more as YAML; the provider reconciles them continuously.

## Overview

- [Provider Keycloak](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/index.md): Crossplane provider for declarative Keycloak management
- [Documentation](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/index.md)
- [Using](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/index.md)

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/getting-started/index.md)

- [First Realm](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/getting-started/first-realm.md): Create your first Keycloak realm with provider-keycloak
- [Installation](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/getting-started/installation.md): Install provider-keycloak into your Crossplane control plane

## Resources

- [Resources](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/index.md)
- [Authentication Flows](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/authentication-flows.md): Customize Keycloak login, MFA, and flow bindings declaratively
- [Client Authorization](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/client-authorization.md): Manage Keycloak authorization resources, permissions, and policies for OpenID clients
- [Clients](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/clients.md): Manage OpenID Connect clients for applications and services
- [Default Configuration](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/default-config.md): Assign default groups and roles to every new user in a realm
- [Groups](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/groups.md): Manage Keycloak groups, memberships, role mappings, and permissions
- [Identity Providers](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/identity-providers.md): Federate Keycloak login with external identity providers
- [OpenID Client Scopes](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/openid-client-scopes.md): Manage reusable OpenID Connect client scopes and assign them as default or optional scopes
- [Organizations](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/organizations.md): Manage Keycloak organizations for multi-tenant realms
- [Protocol Mappers](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/protocol-mappers.md): Manage OIDC and SAML protocol mappers for claims, roles, and group membership
- [Realm Settings](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/realm-settings.md): Configure realm-level settings such as events, required actions, user profiles, localization, keys, scopes, and client policies
- [Realms](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/realms.md): Create and manage Keycloak realms, the top-level container for every other resource
- [Roles](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/roles.md): Manage realm roles and client roles in Keycloak
- [SAML Clients](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/saml-clients.md): Configure SAML 2.0 clients, scopes, and default scopes in Keycloak
- [Service Accounts](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/service-accounts.md): Assign realm and client roles to OpenID client service accounts
- [User Federation](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/user-federation.md): Connect Keycloak to LDAP, Active Directory, and custom user stores
- [Users](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/users.md): Manage users, user role mappings, group memberships, permissions, and custom user federation
- [Workflows](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/using/resources/workflows.md): Automate Keycloak actions in response to realm events

## AI

- [AI Usage](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/ai-usage/index.md)
- [Agents](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/ai-usage/agents.md): Complete coding-agent instructions for provider-keycloak: repo layout, build/test commands (make generate, make test, make e2e), key config files (config/external_name.go, config/<group>/config.go), code-generation rules (never edit apis/ or package/crds/ by hand), known constraints, and common task patterns.
- [LLM Files](https://crossplane-contrib.github.io/provider-keycloak/pr-preview/pr-767/docs/ai-usage/llms.md): provider-keycloak ships /llms.txt (categorized page index for AI agents) and /llms-full.txt (all doc pages concatenated into one file for full-context ingestion). Both are generated by make docs-gen and CI-gated for freshness.
